notes.title: Language update: Chinese(中文).
notes.notes:
The Dew now officially supports Chinese language(中文). You can toggle it in language settings in Option menu.

As always, thanks a lot!

notes.title: The Dew is now available on Steam.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We are glad to announce 'The Dew', developed by team ZZICON, is now released on Steam. The price is $4.99(USD), and 10% launch discount will be held until September 8th, 10:00 A.M.(PST).

We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks a lot!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/692950
